blocks.text: PointOak provides personalized wealth management, investment management, and comprehensive financial planning designed to bring decisions together into one coordinated strategy.
segs: designed to bring decisions together into one coordinated strategy.

sections.title: A Relationship Built Around Your Interests

body.text: Your interests come first.
No investment-product commissions.
No proprietary investment lineup.
Direct access to experienced advisors.

blocks.text: As an SEC-registered investment adviser, PointOak serves its advisory clients as a fiduciary. We are required to act in our clients' best interests and put their interests ahead of our own.

Investment decisions do not happen in isolation. Retirement, taxes, workplace benefits, Social Security, pensions, estate considerations, family priorities, and major life events can all influence how your wealth should be managed. Our role is to help connect those decisions into one coordinated strategy.

body.text: Your investment strategy should reflect your complete financial picture. PointOak builds and manages portfolios using an open-architecture approach that can incorporate traditional and alternative investments when appropriate for the client's objectives and circumstances.
We help coordinate investments, retirement, cash flow, workplace benefits, estate considerations, and other major financial decisions within a comprehensive financial plan.
Changing jobs or retiring can create important decisions around employer retirement accounts.

We help evaluate available options for existing retirement assets and consider rollover and Roth conversion decisions within the context of your investments, taxes, retirement income, and broader financial plan.
The transition from accumulating wealth to drawing income creates an entirely different set of decisions.
We help coordinate portfolio withdrawals, Social Security, pensions, required distributions, taxes, and spending needs within your broader retirement strategy.
Taxes can influence investment decisions, retirement distributions, Roth conversions, asset location, and other aspects of your financial plan.
PointOak incorporates tax-aware planning into the financial and investment decisions we manage while coordinating with your tax professional when appropriate.
Executive compensation can create opportunities—and complexity—that extend well beyond a paycheck.
We help executives evaluate equity compensation, deferred compensation, retirement benefits, and other workplace benefits as part of their broader investment and financial plan.
Social Security and pension elections can affect retirement income for years to come.
We model different claiming and pension scenarios and evaluate them alongside portfolio withdrawals, taxes, longevity considerations, and other retirement-income resources.
Your financial plan and estate plan shouldn't operate independently.
PointOak helps review beneficiaries, account ownership, retirement assets, and other financial considerations while coordinating with your estate attorney and tax professionals.

blocks.text: Your 401(k) may be one of your largest financial assets. Understand your options before you move it. PointOak's experience with both employer-sponsored retirement plans and private wealth management provides perspective on the decisions that can arise when retirement assets transition from the workplace into your broader financial life.

items.title: Broader access can create more ways to build a portfolio.

body.text: For appropriate clients, PointOak may evaluate private credit, private equity, real assets, real estate, hedge fund strategies, structured investments, and other alternative or private-market strategies alongside traditional investments. These investments can involve limited liquidity, longer holding periods, valuation complexity, higher fees, leverage, and eligibility requirements, and they are not appropriate for every client or portfolio.

sections.title: A Boutique Relationship Without a Narrow Perspective

blocks.text: PointOak combines direct access to experienced advisors with broad investment and planning capabilities. When appropriate, we also coordinate with a client’s CPA, estate attorney, and other professionals so important decisions are considered together.

body.text: Learn what matters to you and how the pieces of your financial life fit together.
Build a coordinated investment and planning strategy.
Put agreed recommendations into action.
Review progress and adjust as circumstances, markets, tax rules, and goals change.

a.text: Wealth management combines investment management with broader financial planning. At PointOak, that may include retirement planning, tax-aware strategies, workplace benefits, Social Security and pensions, estate planning coordination, executive benefits, and other financial decisions depending on your circumstances.

items.q: Do you provide both investment management and financial planning?

a.text: Yes. PointOak integrates investment management and financial planning so your portfolio can be considered within the context of your broader goals and financial circumstances.
Yes. PointOak is an SEC-registered investment adviser and serves its advisory clients as a fiduciary.
PointOak is fee-only and is compensated directly by its clients rather than through commissions for selling investment products.

We work with individuals and families seeking ongoing investment management and financial planning, including professionals, executives, business owners, individuals approaching retirement, and retirees.

items.q: Is there a minimum investment amount?

a.text: PointOak's wealth-management relationships vary based on the services needed, portfolio size, complexity, and overall circumstances. The complimentary initial consultation is an opportunity to discuss your goals and determine whether our services are a good fit.

items.q: Can PointOak work with my CPA or estate attorney?

a.text: Yes. When appropriate, we coordinate with clients' tax, legal, insurance, and other professionals so their work can be considered alongside the financial plan.

items.q: What happens during the initial consultation?

a.text: The initial conversation is an opportunity for us to learn about your financial situation, what prompted you to reach out, and the areas where you're looking for help. We'll also explain how PointOak works and answer questions about our services. The initial consultation is complimentary.
